messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content: The “best” month depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, or price—but most travelers find that late spring (May–June) and early fall (September–October) offer the ideal mix of pleasant weather, lower crowds, and better rates. In those months you’ll enjoy warm, sunny days (average highs around 80 °F/27 °C), calm seas for snorkeling and surfing, and fewer tourists than the peak winter‑holiday period.
